messages:
Alex: Taking primary for the night bridge (6h). Pager just fired for generator errors, dropping p99 throughput. Tagging @Priya @Miguel — please standby.
IncidentBot: Pager triggered: GEN_ERR (sev2) at 4523456789. Summary: ~1,200 errors in last 10m, p99 latency ~4200ms, automatic fallback not triggered. Links: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/4523456789
Priya: I'm secondary until 02:00 UTC. Any immediate mitigations I should try first?
Alex: Quick plan: 1) Short-circuit heavy requests to fallback model if error rate stays high. 2) Restart kv-cache deployment on infra nodes serving generator shard. 3) If restart doesn't drop errors in 5m, enable prefix caching bypass for noisy customers.
Miguel: APAC coverage note — I'm warm-standby (on-call but not primary) until 04:00. If latency/p99 stays >3s we should route APAC -> eu-1 fallback pool. I'll help with routing rules.
Seng: Runbooks and quick pointers: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback and https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/GENERATOR+Fallback+Playbook
Seng: Common quick cmds:
```
# restart kv-cache pods on infra nodes (safe short restart)
kubectl -n redwood-system rollout restart deployment/kv-cache
# tail logs for kv-cache (last 200 lines)
kubectl -n redwood-system logs -l app=kv-cache -f --tail=200
```
Priya: If we restart, what's the customer impact? Any live customer-facing errors to note for postmortem?
Alex: Customer impact so far: approx 3% of requests returning 500/timeout, majority from a small set of enterprise tenants behind long prompts. Ticketed as RED-3421 for customer ops. Putting these tenants on bypass reduces error rate to ~0.5%. We're keeping the hosted API open with higher retries for now.
Miguel: If enabling fallback routing, use the following patch to routing-service (canary first):
```json
{ "rule": "route_by_region", "region": "apac", "fallback_pool": "eu-fallback-v2", "canary_pct": 10 }
```
Alex: If fallback looks stable for 10m and error rate <1%, we'll promote to 100% for APAC and then iterate on kv-cache restart/patch.
IncidentBot: Deployment status: no active k8s rollouts detected last 30m. No autoscaler events.
OncallRelay: Quick links for triage: logs -> https://logs.redwood.ai/query?sid=4523456789 ; runbooks -> https://redwood.ai/runbooks ; alert history -> https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/GEN_ERR
Priya: I'll run the restart now and monitor. Will post outputs here.
Priya: (update) restart issued, pods cycling. Watching logs.
Seng: If you see repeated `kv cache miss` + `OOM` traces, consider increasing pod memory or enabling disk-backed cache from the runbook's troubleshooting section.
Priya: (update) errors dropping to ~400 in last 5m, p99 down to 2.1s. Rolling fallback to 30% routing for APAC to be safe.
Alex: Great. Keep monitoring for 20m. If stable, we hand back primary at 02:00. Add a short postmortem note in RED-3421 and include the runbook steps we used.
Miguel: I'll prepare the routing rollback steps in case we need to revert.
OncallRelay: Reminder: leave a short bullet list for next shift — what we tried, customer IDs affected, runbook links, and whether we promoted fallback. Use tag @oncall-handoff.
Alex: Thanks team. Signing off primary at 02:00 unless anything else pops. :thumbsup:
